title: Dedicated capacity: customer readiness rubric and scaled-routing playbook
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Objective: produce a reproducible customer-readiness rubric and a scaled-routing playbook that lets Sales/CS/Onboarding quickly map a customer request to a reserved throughput SLA, GPU family recommendation, and an initial scaling policy. This is a non-bug, product triage effort to lift intake speed, reduce back-and-forth with customers, and standardize fallback behaviors across tiers.

Scope:
- Design a 12-question intake rubric (traffic profile, p50/p95 latency needs, data residency & compliance, expected concurrency, burst tolerance, model family & sequence length distribution, acceptable quantization) that yields a numeric readiness score and recommended SLA band.
- Define three default scaling policy templates (Conservative / Balanced / Aggressive) including autoscale thresholds, burst credit allowances, and preemption/fallback ladder.
- Map SLA bands to GPU family recommendations (e.g., A100x2 for high-throughput low-latency P0, H100/Avx-optimized variants for short sequences, T4/RTX for lower-cost throughput) with cost delta guidance.
- Create a 'scaled-routing playbook' that prescribes routing (region, capacity tier, model variant fallbacks) given capacity constraints and readiness score.
- Produce acceptance criteria, onboarding checklist, and a customer-facing one-pager for AE/CS teams.

Out-of-scope: detailed infra implementation of autoscaler algorithms (ENG will own), and SLA contract language (Legal/Finance will finalize).

Success criteria (measurable):
- Intake-to-recommendation time reduced from avg 4 business days to <24 hours for 80% of requests.
- 90% of incoming enterprise requests map to an SLA+GPU recommendation without follow-up questions.
- First 2 pilot customers onboarded using the rubric with no major SLA revision after 30 days.
acceptance_criteria: Intake rubric published as a Google Doc and embedded into Customer Intake form (CS/AE).
Three scaling policy templates defined with concrete parameter values and playbook steps.
SLA-to-GPU mapping table with estimated monthly cost delta published to internal pricing playbook.
Routing playbook includes at least three fallback scenarios with clear triggers and owner handoffs.
Pilot onboarding runbook and AE one-pager created; 2 pilot customers agreed to try within 6 weeks.
